However multiple course pages explicitly describe 'Live Patient Participation' and hands-on injection of a 'live volunteer patient/model' as part of the curriculum, i.e. the classic model-call pattern the brief flags as a policy call rather than a unilateral EXCLUDE. Per rule 5 (training academy vs academy-with-clinic), this is not decided here.
